leadership.bio_en: The top ruling party leader in the Woreda. He guides political strategy, party institutional builds, ideological dissemination, and acts as the liaison coordinating party policies with district governance objectives.
leadership.bio_am: በወረዳው የገዥው ፓርቲ የበላይ መሪ ናቸው። የፖለቲካ ስትራቴጂዎችን፣ የፓርቲ መዋቅር ግንባታዎችን እና ርዕዮተ-ዓለም ስርጭቶችን የሚመሩ ሲሆን የፓርቲውን ፖሊሲዎች ከመንግስት የልማት ግቦች ጋር ያቀናጃሉ።
leadership.bio_om: Hoogganaa ol'aanaa paartii biyya bulchuuti. Tarsiimoo siyaasaa, ijaarsa dhaabbilee paartii qindeessuun imaammata paartichaa galmaalee misooma mootummaa waliin walsimsiisu.

leadership.title_en: Head of the Political Sector (Prosperity Party)
leadership.bio_en: Operates under the Party Office, directly driving local political mobilization, community alignment forums, leadership capacity building, and structural public evaluation sessions within the woreda's kebeles.
leadership.bio_am: በፓርቲው ጽህፈት ቤት ስር በመሆን በአካባቢው የፖለቲካ ንቅናቄዎችን፣ ህዝባዊ የውይይት መድረኮችን፣ የአመራር አቅም ግንባታዎችን እና የወረዳውን ቀበሌዎች መዋቅራዊ ግምገማዎችን በኃላፊነት ያከናውናሉ።
leadership.bio_om: Waajjira paartii jalatti soochii siyaasaa naannoo, waltajjii marii uummataa, dandeettii hoggana ijaaruu fi gamaggama gandoolee aanaa qindeessuun hojjeta.

leadership.title_am: ምክትል አስተዳዳሪ እና የገቢዎች ጽ/ቤት ሃላፊ
leadership.title_om: Itti Aanaa Bulchaa fi Hoogganaa Waajjira Galiiwwanii
leadership.bio_en: Serves as the second-in-command for public administration while specifically directing the district's finance and revenue-collection frameworks to self-sustain local development budgets.
leadership.bio_am: የወረዳው ሁለተኛ የመንግስት መሪ በመሆን የሚያገለግሉ ሲሆን በተለይም የአካባቢውን የልማት በጀት በራስ ለመደገፍ የገቢ አሰባሰብ እና የፋይናንስ መዋቅሮችን በበላይነት ይመራሉ::
leadership.bio_om: Itti aanaa bulchaa aanaa ta'uun tajaajilu, keessumaa baajata misooma aanaa of danda'uuf sassaabbii galii fi maallaqaa olaantummaan hoogganu.

services.title_am: የወሳኝ ኩነት ምዝገባ (ልደት፣ ጋብቻ፣ ፍቺ፣ ሞት)
services.cost_en: 50 ETB (Government stamp fee; free within 90 days of birth)
services.cost_am: 50 ብር (የቴምብር ክፍያ፤ በ90 ቀናት ውስጥ ለተወለዱ ነጻ)
services.description_en: Legal registration and issuance of official authenticated certificates for births, marriages, divorces, and deaths for residents of Angolela Tera Woreda, in accordance with federal vital event proclamation laws.
services.description_am: በአንጎሌላ ተራ ወረዳ ነዋሪ ለሆኑ ዜጎች በኢትዮጵያ የፌዴራል ወሳኝ ኩነት ምዝገባ ህግ መሰረት የልደት፣ ጋብቻ፣ ፍቺ እና የሞት ይፋዊ ህጋዊ የምስክር ወረቀት ምዝገባና አሰጣጥ።
services.description_om: Akkaataa seera galmee murtii Itoophiyaatti waraqaa ragaa dhalootaa, gaa'elaa fi du'aa lammiilee aanaatiif kennuu.
requirements_en: Official Kebele Resident ID card of parents or applicant
Hospital/Health Center Birth Notification (for births)
Two witnesses with valid government IDs (for marriages/delayed registrations)
Official Medical Death Certificate or Kebele Confirmation (for deaths)
requirements_am: የወላጆች ወይም የአመልካች የቀበሌ የታደሰ መታወቂያ ካርድ
የህክምና ተቋም የልደት ማስታወቂያ ሰነድ (ለልደት ምዝገባ)
ሁለት ህጋዊ መታወቂያ ያላቸው ምስክሮች (ለጋብቻና ለዘገዩ ምዝገባዎች)
የህክምና ተቋም የሞት ማረጋገጫ ወይም የቀበሌ አስተዳደር ማረጋገጫ (ለሞት ምዝገባ)
steps_en: Step 1: Obtain a referral endorsement from your respective Kebele Administration
Step 2: Submit the completed vital event form with supporting documents at the Central Desk in Chacha
Step 3: Verification of records in the National Civil Registry Database
Step 4: Receive laminated official certificate bearing official seal and QR security verification
steps_am: ደረጃ 1፡ በነዋሪነት ከሚገኙበት ቀበሌ አስተዳደር የማረጋገጫ ደብዳቤ መያዝ
ደረጃ 2፡ የተሞላውን ማመልከቻ ሰነድ በጫቻ ማዕከላዊ የወሳኝ ኩነት መስኮት ማቅረብ
ደረጃ 3፡ በብሔራዊ የወሳኝ ኩነት መረጃ ቋት ላይ ትክክለኛነቱ ሲረጋገጥ ማጽደቅ
ደረጃ 4፡ ማህተም የተደረገበትንና የQR ኮድ ጥበቃ ያለውን ይፋዊ የምስክር ወረቀት መረከብ
steps_om: Tarkaanfii 1: Ganda irraa waraqaa deeggarsaa fiduu
Tarkaanfii 2: Waajjira Caaccetti argamuutti iyyannoo galchuu
Tarkaanfii 3: Ragaa sirna kompiitaraa irratti mirkaneessuu
Tarkaanfii 4: Waraqaa ragaa asxaa mootummaa qabu fudhachuu

services.title_am: የገጠር መሬት ይዞታ ምዝገባ፣ ደብተርና ዝውውር
services.cost_en: 100 ETB (Certificate book printing & cadastral map fee)
services.description_en: Issuance and official updating of the Second-Level Rural Landholding Certificate (Green Book) including plot boundary coordinates, family member rights, inheritance, and legal rental agreements.
services.description_am: የአርሶ አደር ይዞታን የሚያረጋግጥ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ የይዞታ ማረጋገጫ ደብተር (አረንጓዴ ደብተር) አሰጣጥ፣ የወሰን ቅየሳ፣ የውርስና የስሪት ዝውውር ምዝገባ።
services.description_om: Waraqaa ragaa qabiyyee lafaa sadarkaa 2ffaa (kitaaba magariisa) kennuu fi daddabarsa dhaalaa mirkaneessuu.
requirements_en: Original primary land certificate or parcel demarcation map
Kebele Land Administration Committee (KLAC) resolution minute
Consent agreement signed by all legal spouses and registered household members
Court decree or inheritance arbitration ruling (for estate divisions)
requirements_am: ዋናው የቀድሞ ይዞታ ደብተር ወይም የመሬት ልኬት ካርታ
የቀበሌ የመሬት አስተዳደርና አጠቃቀም ኮሚቴ (KLAC) የውሳኔ ቃለ-ጉባዔ
የባለቤቶች (የትዳር አጋሮች) እና የቤተሰብ አባላት የጋራ ስምምነት ፊርማ
የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ወይም የውርስ አጣሪ ሰነድ (ለውርስ ጉዳዮች)
requirements_om: Mallattoo waliigaltee abbaa warraa fi haadha warraa
steps_en: Step 1: Application submission to the Kebele Land Administration Committee
Step 2: Field surveyor boundary verification using handheld GPS equipment
Step 3: 30-day public notice for boundary objection clearance at the Kebele office
Step 4: Formal issuance of laminated Green Certificate at the Woreda Land Bureau in Chacha
steps_am: ደረጃ 1፡ በቀበሌው የመሬት አስተዳደር ኮሚቴ ማመልከቻ ማቅረብ
ደረጃ 2፡ የባለሙያ የመስክ ልኬት በጂፒኤስ (GPS) መከናወንና የወሰን ማረጋገጥ
ደረጃ 3፡ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ አለመኖሩን ለማረጋገጥ ለ30 ቀናት የሚቆይ ይፋዊ ማስታወቂያ
ደረጃ 4፡ በጫቻ የወረዳው መሬት አስተዳደር ጽ/ቤት አረንጓዴውን የይዞታ ደብተር መረከብ
steps_om: Tarkaanfii 1: Koree lafaa gandaatti iyyannoo galchuu
Tarkaanfii 2: Ogeessi GPS dhaan lafa safaruu
Tarkaanfii 3: Beeksisa guyyoota 30 ganda irratti maxxansuu
Tarkaanfii 4: Waajjira aanaatti kitaaba fudhachuu

services.title_am: የንግድ ምዝገባ፣ የንግድ ፈቃድና አመታዊ እድሳት
services.cost_en: Varies by sector (120 ETB – 500 ETB fixed statutory registration fee)
services.cost_am: እንደ ንግድ ዘርፉ ይለያያል (ከ120 ብር እስከ 500 ብር ህጋዊ ክፍያ)
services.description_en: Full-service commercial licensing for sole proprietorships, partnerships, and private limited companies operating in retail, grain trade, transport, manufacturing, and hospitality within Angolela Tera.
services.description_am: በአንጎሌላ ተራ ወረዳ ለሚሰሩ የችርቻሮ፣ የእህል ንግድ፣ የአግሮ-ፕሮሰሲንግ፣ የትራንስፖርትና የእንግዳ ተቀባይነት ንግዶች ፈቃድ መስጠትና ማደስ።
services.description_om: Daldala dhuunfaa, waldaalee fi industiriif hayaama daldalaa haaraa kennuu fi haaromsuu.
requirements_en: Valid Tax Identification Number (TIN) certificate
Two passport-sized photographs of applicant / general manager
Commercial lease agreement or proof of property ownership in Chacha/woreda
Sectoral Competency Certificate (for pharmaceuticals, fuel stations, clinics)
requirements_am: የታክስ ከፋይ መለያ ቁጥር (TIN) ሰነድ
የአመልካቹ ሁለት የቅርብ ጊዜ የፓስፖርት መጠን ፎቶግራፍ
የንግድ ቦታ የኪራይ ውል ወይም የይዞታ ማረጋገጫ
የሙያ ብቃት ማረጋገጫ ምስክር ወረቀት (እንደ ስራው ባህሪ)
steps_en: Step 1: Verify proposed trade name availability at the licensing counter
Step 2: Submit application and sector compliance verification documentation
Step 3: Complete payment at Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) government revenue account
Step 4: Receive laminated Commercial Registration and Business License certificate
steps_am: ደረጃ 1፡ በንግድ ስም መዝገብ ላይ የስም ተይዞ አለመኖርን ማረጋገጥ
ደረጃ 2፡ ማመልከቻውንና የብቃት ማረጋገጫ ሰነዶችን ለፈቃድ ኦፊሰሩ ማቅረብ
ደረጃ 3፡ ህጋዊ የአገልግሎት ክፍያ በኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንክ የወረዳው ገቢ ሂሳብ መክፈል
ደረጃ 4፡ የንግድ ምዝገባና የንግድ ፈቃድ ምስክር ወረቀቱን በዕለቱ መረከብ
steps_om: Tarkaanfii 1: Maqaa daldalaa mirkaneeffachuu
Tarkaanfii 2: Galmee iyyannoo dhiheessuu
Tarkaanfii 3: Kaffaltii baankii daldalaa Itoophiyaatti kaffaluu
Tarkaanfii 4: Waraqaa hayaama daldalaa fudhachuu

services.title_am: የማህበረሰብ አቀፍ ጤና መድህን (CBHI) ምዝገባና እድሳት
services.officeName_en: Woreda Health Office & Kebele Health Posts
services.officeName_am: የወረዳው ጤና ጥበቃ ጽ/ቤትና የቀበሌ ጤና ኬላዎች
services.officeName_om: Waajjira Eegumsa Fayyaa fi Keellaa Fayyaa
services.cost_en: 600 ETB / household / year (Indigent households 100% subsidized by woreda)
services.cost_am: 600 ብር ለአንድ አባወራ በዓመት (አቅመ ደካሞች በወረዳው በነጻ ይሸፈናሉ)
services.cost_om: Qarshii 600 waggaatti maatii tokkoof (Harka qalleeyyiif bilisa)
services.description_en: Enrollment in the regional solidarity health insurance fund ensuring family members receive free medical treatment, diagnostics, and essential pharmaceuticals across all government hospitals and health centers.
services.description_am: መላው የቤተሰብ አባላት በወረዳው ባሉ ጤና ጣቢያዎችና በጫቻ ሆስፒታል ነጻ የህክምና፣ የላቦራቶሪና የመድሃኒት አገልግሎት የሚያገኙበት የማህበረሰብ አቀፍ የጤና መድህን ምዝገባ።
services.description_om: Maatiin hundi buufata fayyaa fi hospitaala keessatti yaala bilisaa akka argatan galmee inshuraansii fayyaa hawaasaa gaggeessuu.
requirements_en: Kebele Resident Family Roster booklet
One photograph of household head and list of eligible dependents under 18
Annual premium contribution receipt or Kebele indigent subsidy exemption slip
requirements_am: የቀበሌ የቤተሰብ አባላት መመዝገቢያ ሰነድ
የአባወራው/እማወራዋ ፎቶግራፍና እድሜያቸው ከ18 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ልጆች ዝርዝር
አመታዊ የአባልነት ክፍያ ደረሰኝ ወይም የአቅመ-ደካማነት ማረጋገጫ ደብዳቤ
requirements_om: Suuraa abbaa warraa fi maqaa ijoollee
steps_en: Step 1: Register during annual renewal season with your Kebele CBHI representative
Step 2: Verify registered family members and verify medical facility linkage
Step 3: Receive stamped official CBHI family health booklet

news.summary_en: The Woreda Council convened for its ordinary session in Chacha, formally ratifying the annual public expenditure plan prioritizing rural water schemes, primary road graveling, and agricultural cooperative subsidies.
news.summary_am: የአንጎሌላ ተራ ወረዳ ምክር ቤት በጫቻ ከተማ ባካሄደው መደበኛ ጉባዔ ለንጹህ መጠጥ ውሃ መስፋፋት፣ ለገጠር መንገዶች ጠጠር ማልበስ እና ለአርሶ አደር ማህበራት ድጋፍ ቅድሚያ የሰጠውን በጀት አጸደቀ።
news.summary_om: Manni maree aanaa baajata ijaarsa daandii, bishaan qulqulluu fi deeggarsa qonnaan bultootaaf oolu guutummaatti mirkaneessee jira.
content_en: The 6th Angolela Tera Woreda Council has concluded its high-level ordinary session following two days of constructive deliberations in the administrative hall at Chacha town.

The approved budget prioritizes three major socioeconomic pillars: the expansion of deep water borehole schemes across 6 moisture-stressed kebeles, the upgrade of 45 kilometers of community feeder roads connecting farming villages to the main A2 highway, and modernization subsidies for local agricultural cooperatives.

Chief Administrator of the Woreda, in his address to council members, underscored that fiscal transparency, timely project completion, and strict monitoring of public expenditure will remain the uncompromising standards of the executive cabinet.

news.summary_en: Over 14,000 quintals of certified rust-resistant wheat seed and balanced NPS-B fertilizer are being distributed to smallholder farmers ahead of the meher harvest season.

content_en: The Angolela Tera Woreda Agriculture and Rural Development Office has officially launched the mass distribution of certified agricultural inputs across all kebele multipurpose union service stations.

The input package focuses on the highly productive, stripe rust-resistant bread wheat varieties suitable for highland elevations above 2,600 meters, ensuring optimal grain yields even during fluctuating seasonal rain patterns.

Field development agents (DAs) are actively providing localized technical demonstrations on cluster farming, balanced fertilizer application, and mechanized sowing techniques to ensure farmers achieve maximum productivity.

content_en: Angolela Tera Woreda is rapidly positioning itself as the premier agro-industrial processing destination in the North Shewa Zone of the Amhara Region.

Benefiting from direct access to the paved A2 trunk road, proximity to Debre Birhan and Addis Ababa, abundant electricity from the national grid, and plentiful high-quality spring water, the Chacha corridor offers unmatched logistical advantages.
Qualified investors will enjoy expedited one-stop clearances, competitive 70-year lease terms, local raw material supply guarantees, and dedicated administrative support.
